comments.author: @EvervistaTravel66
comments.text: The words "money can't buy" are what make this title interesting. At first, they sound like a promise of an exclusive destination. But they also raise a more meaningful question: what about a place should never be reduced to a price tag? A coastline can be photographed and a vacation can be booked, but a community's sense of home isn't something a visitor can purchase. That's the story I'd most want to understand.
